correctness.rationale: Cross-edge completion is exactly the P3-induced-path Horn rule. Fixed K4 core and two-neighbor attachments force all active edges within two rounds. The only missing first-round edges are cherry pairs. Pairwise-intersecting-edge classification exhausts fixed sets, establishing gradedness, rank polynomial and cardinality. Boundary ratios plus binomial strict log-concavity prove all n; atomic crosscut and inclusion-exclusion prove Möbius; atom-join adjacency reconstructs T_n and its automorphisms. Exhaustive independently-coded checks for n=4..6, interval Möbius n=4,5, and n<=100 coefficient checks corroborate.

value.rationale: Natural Horn closure on a highly symmetric infinite family exhibits provably sharp two-round inference, exact lattice rank profile with strict log-concavity, an exact Möbius invariant and a genuine small-dimension automorphism anomaly. The classification gives structural rather than merely finite-enumeration information and distinguishes triangular graphs from earlier triangle-free line-graph results.
